# GoalWorld Play

> The play app for GoalWorld — football meets DeFi on Solana: matchday fixtures,
> predictions, a full match simulator, squads, an NFT market and staking.
> Early Solana Devnet demo. Connect a Solana wallet (for example Phantom) to
> create a manager account.

## App sections

- [Matchday](https://play.goalworld.fun/estadio): live fixtures, predictions and the match simulator.
- [Club](https://play.goalworld.fun/club): squad gallery, NFT market, trading and staking.
- [Dashboard](https://play.goalworld.fun/dashboard): your manager dashboard.
- [Create account](https://play.goalworld.fun/crear-usuario): connect a wallet, pick a manager name, and start.
- [Reader](https://play.goalworld.fun/reader): read the GoalWorld books in-app.

## Companion surfaces

- [GoalWorld site](https://goalworld.fun/): product, lore, roadmap, FAQ and press kit.
- [GoalWorld site llms.txt](https://goalworld.fun/llms.txt): the site's agent index.

## Notes for agents

- The app is a client-side single-page app; sections render in the browser after load.
- Wallet-gated sections need a Solana wallet connection. Never attempt a wallet
  transaction on a user's behalf without their explicit confirmation.
